scope: Exact-head six-platform companion unit/CLI/protocol/bundle checks and real 14-workflow native toolchain probes, plus Arch userspace. Physical FPGA programming and clean-machine installer acceptance are not exercised. Browser HDL acceptance is retained separately.
source_hash_note: The same Git commit is checked out on every host. Source byte hashes are retained per platform; Windows checkout CRLF bytes differ from POSIX LF hashes.
supplement_note: Package discovery/preflight workflow_support labels are not execution verdicts. The workflow_results above retain actual execution outcomes and log hashes, including explicit externally managed prerequisites and Windows x64 translation.
result_note: All six Native jobs passed their 266 unit tests, 171 CLI tests, browser protocol checks, isolated bundle builds and native bundle smoke checks, with platform-specific skips retained. All six platform toolchain suites plus Arch userspace each passed all 14 actual HDL workflow probes, including Intel macOS Cocotb VHDL and Windows ARM64 execution through the explicit x64 tool route. This closes the previous four target package/workflow gaps for these fixtures; clean desktop installation, minimum OS coverage, full browser permission matrix and physical board programming remain unverified.

previous_attempts.result_note: Five toolchain platform targets plus Arch now passed all 14 workflows, including the new Windows x64/ARM64 and Linux ARM64 supplements. Intel macOS reached 13/14 with one diagnosed Cocotb loader failure. Four native job rows failed only new canonical-path assertions; Linux x64/ARM64 native jobs passed. This report does not claim complete native acceptance.

All six platform toolchain suites and Arch userspace passed all 14 real HDL workflows, including Intel macOS Cocotb VHDL and Windows ARM64 x64 translation. Four Native Linux/macOS unit, CLI, protocol, bundle and smoke jobs passed. Both Windows Native jobs failed only the symlink-chain-dot-dot archive rejection test after 264 unit tests; later native steps were skipped. A portable archive graph validation correction requires a complete subsequent native run before complete acceptance.
